reviews.t: The regular is better than the waterproof
reviews.x: I LOVE the fairydrops regular mascara-- it's the best mascara I've ever used. But after trying the waterproof, I got a totally different experience. It didn't apply as smoothly and there are clumps everywhere. So disappointed but at least I know I love the regular kind.

I've been on a mascara safari lately (ever since my beloved Max Factor 2000 Calorie Mascara was discontinued in the US.) I received a trial version of the Fairydrops Scandal Queen mascara with a Sephora value pack. I loved it - and now I love the waterproof version even more. That wonky-looking brush? It really adds volume and length (without clumps.) And the teeny-tiny teeth on the wand? They are great at catching the finest eyelashes at the corners of my eyes. Because I am vain, I tried wearin

Well, I gave this a try after  getting recommendations for it due to its good-for-your-eyelashes ingredients. I was very disappointed at the outcome of this mascara on my lashes.  It clumps. It smears. Its sticky (as in days after use it stuck my eyelashes together to the point of visual impairment). It takes a long time to get off and even with makeup remover it does not come off completely. It took me days to relieve my eyelashes from this stuff and to get my lashes to stop clumping together.

reviews.t: Definitely volumizes, holds curl - but those with sensitive eyes, BEWARE
reviews.x: I've only used this a few times and I have to say, it seriously holds a curl.  I slept with my makeup on and by afternoon the following day, the mascara looked fresh as ever.  I also took a shower and the mascara didn't budge, so it's definitely waterproof, too.  One thing I wish I had paid attention to before purchasing was that the formula incorporates fibers, which tend to irritate sensitive eyes.  All day, I find fibers flaking off into my eyes, making them red and watery.  I haven't had suc

reviews.t: Was - Best. Mascara. Ever. Now - Just Okay
reviews.x: I've been using this product for several years - the tube color has changed & the formulation with it. Old formula - quick to apply, super long lashes without clumps, fully waterproof but amazingly easy to remove with a cloth & water & tiny bit of soap. New forumla - quick to apply, kinda long lashes still no clumps, fully waterproof ... & now so hard to remove that I scrub my eyes & wind up with irritated under-eye skin.

reviews.t: This mascara is AMAZING. Truly does a wonderful job holding a curl ...
reviews.x: This mascara is AMAZING. Truly does a wonderful job holding a curl in sparse eyelashes, all day.  It's a super waterproof, so wear it every other day, to let lashes rest after you scrub it off xD

I've tried all kinds of different mascara's that either didn't do anything or turned me into a "raccoon" by the end of the day.  I have skimpy lashes and oily lids.  I tried Lancome Hypnose waterproof that absolutely did nothing for my lashes.  I also tried Benefit They're real which was nice but tended to clump.  I then decided to try this one after doing some research on-line and how this was good for Asian type lashes.  This stuff is amazing and didn't clump at all, looked natural onl

reviews.t: Holds curl, creates volume, possibly not great for sensitive skin/eyes/contact lens wearers
reviews.x: I love this mascara. I love that it creates volume, holds the curl to my lashes, but I believe this irritated my eyes. I wear contact lenses, and my eyes felt incredibly sore after wearing this mascara the next day, and I think it's because of the fibers in the mascara that irritated my eyes. If you don't have sensitive eyes, I highly recommend this. Also, I did find smudging underneath my eyes at the end of the day, but I have yet to find a mascara that hasn't smudged on me so maybe it's just m

I love this mascara.  Before this one, I tried several mascaras; no matter the cost, they tend to form lumps and because of my oily skin, I always had the raccoon eyes problem. This mascara solved both problems, it lasts longer compared to other mascaras because it does not dry or forms lumps over time, is easy to apply and stays all day long, very easy to remove as well.
I was looking for something that made my eyes pop;  this did not.  it is cakey and not worth the money you spend of it
My favorite mascara! I've been using it for years and nothing works better

Bought after reading an article on mascaras that work on straight-as-a-board Asian eyelashes.  I must curl my eyelashes otherwise they stick straight down.  With lots of brands of mascaras, the eyelashes fall back down after application.  Then I have to curl my lashes AFTER mascara application with means pulled out eyelashes & a gunky eyelash curler. Compared to the ones I've tried (only cheaply priced), this one allows the lash to remain curled.  Cover Girl Professional 3-in-1 Waterproof works

reviews.t: My favorite mascara! Please read! So glad it's carried here
reviews.x: I used to purchase this from Sephora but they no longer carry it. I have short, fine, asian lashes and this stuff is amazing! I curl my lashes and then apply 1 coat of this and it never smudges, even with my combination complexion. I have gone through at least 5 of these and am so glad that Amazon carries this, especially with Prime. This doesn't smudge because it has the "tube" technology, and works better for curling and lengthening because there are tiny fibers in the formula (again,

I am sooooo confused on why this has so many good reviews. I was so excited to order this, I got it express shipped from Amazon and paid 30 bucks total. It is by far the worst mascara I've ever used. It is too wet and it doesn't hold a curl whatsoever (I tried curling before and after).  I even got the waterproof version bc I know those usually hold a curl better... but not in this case. No length and you need at least four coats to get any volume. Is there a trick to this that I just don't know

I have super sensitive eyes and bought this hoping that I would be able to wear it.  It goes on nicely.  I like the brush it came with.  Very pretty tube. Stayed on without smudging or flaking for the almost nine hours that I was able to wear it.  Unfortunately, my eyes started tearing and burning an hour or so after I applied it.  So, I had to give it away after just one use.  If you have sensitive eyes, this may not work for you either.

reviews.t: Don’t waste your time or money.
reviews.x: This mascara sucks. I bought it years ago from Sephora and loved it. Then they discontinued it and I moved on to Dior. So I found it here and though oh awesome. I should have saved my money. It doesn’t lengthen or curl. It’s clumpy. It irritates my eye. It’s terrible to remove. It transfers to my eye lid. I tried using one of the wands from my old door bottle and it’s still a horrible mascara. I should of just gotten my usual.

This is the best mascara I have ever used for my thin and straight Asian lashes.  I have used every single kind for thickening, lengthening, staying curled and non smudging and this has met all of the criteria mentioned. I have used both the waterproof and non waterproof version and they are both great. It is hard to find a mascara to keep my straight lashes curled after using an eyelash curler and this does the trick!

This is my favorite mascara. I purchased the non-waterproof version at Sephora while they still carried it and I loved it...except that it smudges over my makeup after a while. I got the waterproof version and problem solved! My eyelashes stay curled too, which is something you might take for granted if you don't have super straight hair (and eyelashes, obviously) like me.

I was really excited about this mascara based on all this reviews, but in all honesty its nothing special. My lashes normally have a slight curl, I was hoping for this to enhance that curl, instead it straightened them. I tried the next time to curl my lashes and still..this products makes my lashes stick straight forward meaning they are less visable. Super disappointed.

i have very oily skin and this mascara is the only one that doesn't run for me.  it's not a very "wet" formula, which i love.  having short and sparse lashes, i feel like this lengthens and volumizes.  and in addition to it being a dryer formula, i feel like it doesn't weigh down the curl after using an eyelash curler.  will continue to buy and use.

I used this mascara in the past and really loved it, but this time around it was a total fail.  I'm not sure if they changed the formulation or what, but I had to return it this time because it just would not stay on.  I will say it does look good when you put it on, but it just doesn't stay, which is a major concern for me.

I love this mascara, so I was very excited to find it on Amazon. Unfortunately the mascara I received is not real thing, it doesn't contains same ingredients as original one - I still have a box from the first one, and it doesn't come off, with soap, or makeup remover, a real disappointment!

I have super straight lashes, but I've found if I use waterproof mascara after curling them, they stay put all day. This stuff is great because it separates your lashes and sets them. I used to only use DiorShow, but was happy to come across this.

fibers in it make your lashes look ridiculously long, and from a girl with heavy asian eyelids, this is the first mascara I've ever had not smudge.  it lasts forever, and both the normal and waterproof versions have serious staying power.

reviews.t: I found I did not like this as much as their water resistant version
reviews.x: I found I did not like this as much as their water resistant version. This was much harder to get off and tended to clump/dry out faster. Only used this one tube and wasnt a huge fan.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the mascara for holding a curl all day, especially on straight or sparse lashes.
Several reviewers report clumping, smearing, or a cakey application.
Some reviewers with sensitive eyes or contact lenses report irritation, burning, or tearing.
Reviewers frequently describe it as truly waterproof and long-lasting without smudging.
A few reviewers note the formula changed and is now worse than the previous version.
